item.title: Sector Update: Tech Stocks Gain Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:44 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) ri
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:44 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Tech stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLK) rising 2.3% and the State Street SPDR S&P Semiconductor ETF (XSD) adding 4.1%. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index advanced 3.1%. In corporate news, SpaceX (SPCX) has had internal talks about purchasing operational and customer data from troubled or defunct startups to help improve its AI models, Bloomberg reported. SpaceX shares rose 2.9%. Boost Run (BRUN) shares jumped past 8% after the company said it will join the Russell 2000 and Russell 3000 indexes as part of FTSE Russell's quarterly initial public offering additions. GlobalFoundries (GFS) and Marvell Technology (MRVL) said Thursday they will increase capacity for GlobalFoundries' silicon germanium technology at its facility in Burlington, Vermont, under an expanded multiyear agreement. GlobalFoundries shares jumped 6%, and Marvell climbed 5%. Generac (GNRC) said Wednesday it has signed a long-term supply agreement with Amazon (AMZN), with initial deliveries of backup power generators for data centers expected to reach $2.4 billion in 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares added 2.2%.

item.title: Sector Update: Consumer Stocks Advance Late Afternoon
item.description: 03:40 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ET
item.dc:creator: MT newswire
item.content:encoded: 03:40 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Consumer stocks were higher late Thursday afternoon, with the State Street Consumer Staples Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLP) increasing 0.2% and the State Street Consumer Discretionary Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLY) rising 1.2%. In corporate news, YETI (YETI) shares rose 3.3% after the company said it is targeting annual adjusted earnings per share growth of low double-digit to high teens and annual net sales growth of mid-single-digit to high-single-digit through fiscal 2030. Mondelez International (MDLZ), Hershey (HSY), Kraft Heinz (KHC), General Mills (GIS) and other food companies will continue to face potential sales declines due to the rising use of GLP-1 treatment for weight loss, but the introduction of pills could lower the impact on sales, Bloomberg reported, citing Bloomberg Intelligence research. Mondelez shares were down 0.3%, Hershey was shedding 0.8%, Kraft rose 0.7%, and General Mills was fractionally lower. Lucid (LCID) CEO Silvio Napoli said Thursday on Bloomberg Television that the company finalized its work with restructuring advisers. Lucid's work with AlixPartners concluded after the adviser was brought in to help the electric-vehicle maker achieve $1.4 billion in cash savings this year, the report said. Lucid shares jumped past 6%. XPeng (XPEV) plans to offer its technology to foreign automakers other than its partner Volkswagen as it looks for new revenue streams, Reuters reported. XPeng shares added 3%.

item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は１７日、ポーランドのナブロツキ大統領の「大胆なリーダーシップ」によって、同国への米軍基地設置計画が進展していると述べた。

トランプ氏は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「実現すれば、場所は間もなく発表されるだろう。これは偉大な米・ポーランド同盟にとって歴史的な一歩となる」と表明した。

「これが実現すれば、設置場所はまもなく発表されるだろう。これは、我々の偉大なる米・ポーランド同盟にとって歴史的な一歩となるだろう」と、トランプ氏は「Truth Social」への投稿で述べた。

ナブロツキ大統領はＸへの投稿で、トランプ大統領に謝意を示した上で、ポーランドが「防衛協力の強化に向けた取り組みを継続する用意がある」と表明。さらに「米軍基地に最適な場所を提供するため、ポーランド政府は尽力することを約束する」と述べた。

ポーランド大統領府長官もＸで「ポーランドにとって素晴らしいニュースだ」と歓迎。プーチン大統領率いるロシアが「自由世界を脅かすこの時期に、そして旧ソ連によるポーランド侵攻から８７年の節目に、米大統領がポーランドへの米軍基地設置を発表したことは重要な意味を持つ」と述べた。

item.content:encoded: 03:30 PM EDT, 09/17/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Energy stocks advanced late Thursday afternoon, with the NYSE Energy Sector Index up 0.6% and the State Street Energy Select Sector SPDR ETF (XLE) adding 0.5%. The Philadelphia Oil Service Sector Index was fractionally lower, and the Dow Jones US Utilities Index increased 0.8%. Front-month West Texas Intermediate crude oil shed 1% to $101.41 a barrel, and the global benchmark Brent crude contract fell 1.5% to $104.22 a barrel. In corporate news, HighPeak Energy (HPK) is considering a potential sale, working with investment bankers from Evercore (EVR) and Texas Capital Bancshares (TCBI) subsidiary Texas Capital Securities, Reuters reported. HighPeak shares jumped past 5%.

Sept 17 : AI infrastructure provider Crusoe said on Thursday it has raised $3.9 billion at a post-money valuation of $30.9 billion, as demand for computing capacity to power AI workloads continues to surge. Launched in 2018 as a cryptocurrency business, Crusoe later pivoted to building AI infrastructure and is among the upcoming "neoclouds" that provide specialized AI cloud and data center services. • The Series F round was co-led by Atreides Management, Mubadala Capital and Valor Equity Partners, alongside significant backing from new and existing investors including Founders Fund, Nvidia and QIA, among others. • Crusoe will use the proceeds to expand its existing programs and support the build-out of its own AI factories.

• Highlighting the scale of investment flowing into the sector, Blackstone and Alphabet’s AI cloud venture Crux AI secured a $22 billion chip loan, alongside an initial $5 billion equity investment from Blackstone. • The rapid pace of AI development is also raising concerns, with top industry executives calling for slower advances amid mounting fears the technology could be misused. • Denver, Colorado-based Crusoe said it has more than $140 billion in total contracted value and over 6 gigawatts of contracted capacity, with 1 GW already operational.

item.title: Floodwater overwhelmed pump at Exxon Mobil's Joliet, Illinois refinery; facility remains offline following outage
item.description: Exxon Mobil said floodwater overwhelmed a pump at its 275,000-barrel-per-day refinery in Joliet, Illinois, according to a filing on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Nicole Jao
item.content:encoded: Exxon Mobil (XOM.N) said floodwater overwhelmed a pump at its 275,000-barrel-per-day refinery in Joliet, Illinois, according to a filing on Thursday. A containment boom had been deployed as part of the cleanup effort, the filing shows. Exxon took the Joliet refinery offline on Sunday after a power outage triggered the facility's safety flare. The source of the outage was found on ComEd's primary and secondary power lines feeding into the Joliet refinery, the company said in a statement on Thursday, adding that power to the refinery was fully restored. The company declined to say whether the pump issue was linked to the power outage. Industry monitor IIR Energy had expected return to normal service by [USN:L6N4560VN TEXT:"the end of this week"]. The refinery remains offline as of Thursday, according to Wood Mackenzie. The refinery flared again on Wednesday, according to Patrick De Haan, head of petroleum analysis at GasBuddy, who posted about the incident on X. The Joliet refinery is a key fuel supplier to the U.S. Midwest. According to the company's website, it can produce about 11 million gallons per day of gasoline and diesel fuel. The disruption comes amid a tight global fuel market, with the conflict in the Middle East and Ukrainian attacks on Russian refineries putting pressure on fuel supplies. The U.S. national average price of diesel surpassed $6 a gallon last week and continued to rise this week.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（17日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
ロンドン株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が金利を据え置くと決定。...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（17日） 4:04 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

ロンドン株式市場は続伸して取引を終えた。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）が金利を据え置くと決定。国債の売却停止も発表し、英国債利回りが大幅に低下したことを受け、買い注文が優勢だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は１．１７％上昇した。

英中銀のベイリー総裁は、中東での武力衝突が長引けば、金融引き締めが必要になる可能性があるとの認識を示した。ＬＳＥＧによると、年内に少なくとも０．２５％ポイントの利上げが見込まれ、追加利上げの可能性も高まっている。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は１６日、０．２５％ポイントの利上げを決めた。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．５９％高。金融大手ＨＳＢＣは２．０％、スタンダード・チャータードは２．２％それぞれ上昇した。

製薬大手アストラゼネカは２．４％高。中国での生産増強に向けた投資を表明し、買われた。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続伸して取引を終えた。原油高一服や金利低下を好感した。主要地域指数の大半が上昇した。

サウジアラビアがオマーン経由の原油積み出しを拡大していると報じられ、ブレント原油先物は続落した。ただ依然として高値圏で推移している。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が３年２カ月ぶりに利上げを決定し、主要中銀がインフレ抑制に向けた取り組みを強化しているとの見方が強まった。米国債利回りは１７日の取引で低下した。

８月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）改定値は前年同月比３．２％上昇と、速報値の３．３％上昇から下方修正された。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種資源株指数は１．９６％高。自動車・部品株指数は１．６１％高。ドイツの自動車大手ＢＭＷは１．７％、フランス自動車大手ルノー・グループは２．４％、ドイツの自動車大手フォルクスワーゲン（ＶＷ）は２．７％、いずれも上昇した。

石油・ガス株指数は０．１８％高。議会総選挙の結果を受けてクリステション首相が辞任する意向を表明したスウェーデンのＯＭＸストックホルム指数は１．０６％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが序盤の上昇から反転して低下した。原油価格が下落したことに加え、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行、ＢＯＥ）が量的引き締め（ＱＴ）政策を転換し、国債売却を全て一時停止すると決定したことを受け、英国債が急伸した。

英中銀は１７日、予想通り政策金利を据え置いた。また、国債（ギルト債）の売却を今後６カ月間停止するとともに、長期債の売却は全面的に中止すると発表した。

発表を受けて、英国債利回りは大幅に低下、域内国債利回りも小幅に低下した。

こうした中、域内市場は原油と天然ガスの高値にも注視している。ノルデア銀行のチーフアナリストは「欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の追加利上げを回避するには、エネルギー価格が急速に下落する必要がある」と述べた。

ユーロ圏の指標金利であるドイツの１０年債利回りは３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の３．４８１７％。

ＥＣＢの政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りはほぼ横ばいの３．２０９６％となった。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が前日、約３年ぶりの利上げに踏み切り、追加利上げの可能性を示唆したことを受け、短期ゾーンの域内国債利回りは序盤には上昇していた。

ユーロ圏金融・債券市場：[DE/BJ]

item.title: Intense Heat Strains Power Grids for 100 Million North Americans
item.description: Power grids serving more than 100 million North Americans are bracing for a demand surge as unseasonable heat strains electrical equipment scheduled for repairs.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- Power grids serving more than 100 million North Americans are bracing for a demand surge as unseasonable heat strains electrical equipment scheduled for repairs.Temperatures are running more than 20F (11C) above normal in some areas served by the Midcontinent Independent System Operator, with triple-digit heat forecast around the South through at least Sunday, according to the US National Weather Service. St. Louis is forecast to reach 99F (37C) and is under a heat advisory through late Saturday, according to the National Weather Service. That’s about 18F higher than normal for this time of year.Meanwhile, a neighboring grid managed by PJM Interconnection LLC that encompasses Chicago, Washington DC and Virginia’s Data Center Alley issued an alert that reserve power supplies are under strain in some areas and ordered some major, non-residential customers to cut back. The searing weather arrived just as power-plant operators were scheduled to take key systems offline for autumn maintenance. MISO reported roughly 51 gigawatts of generation outages Thursday even as demand is forecast to reach 105.2 gigawatts. PJM expects electricity usage to surpass 132 gigawatts, with nearly 37 offline.PJM officials requested Wednesday that the US Department of Energy waive some emissions rules so plants can operate at full tilt. The agency also authorized the deployment of backup generation resources Thursday to mitigate any potential shortages.Spot power prices in the largest US grid jumped above $4,300 per megawatt-hour on the benchmark Western hub just after 6 p.m. local time Wednesday.Aging generating stations are coming off a summer of brutal heat that prompted repeated federal orders to run at full blast. That’s put additional stress on a system facing growing industrial and data center demand. PJM’s generation fleet “is starting to show signs of its age when trying to stay working,” said Gary Cunningham, a director at Tradition Energy.Wholesale power prices probably will remain elevated across Virginia, Ohio, Kentucky and western Pennsylvania through Thursday, Cunningham added.Autumn in the Northern Hemisphere is typically an ideal time to conduct maintenance on power gear as milder weather eases air-conditioner use. But erratic weather linked to both human-caused climate change and natural phenomena like El Niño is squeezing the repair calendar. Increasingly, plant operators are finding there is no off-season. The artificial intelligence boom is also boosting overall electricity demand, which means critical equipment doesn’t get much of a break. Unseasonable weather “plays well into the narrative of PJM needing more generation capacity, and needing it NOW, even before new demands to meet data center requirements come,” Cunningham wrote in an email.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.title: US to allow Iranian leaders to attend UN General Assembly
item.description: The Trump administration will allow top Iranian officials to attend the United Nations General Assembly in New York next week, the State Department said on Thursday, even as Washington and Tehran remain at war and continue intermittent talks aimed at ending the conflict.
item.dc:creator: Simon Lewis
item.content:encoded: The Trump administration will allow top Iranian officials to attend the United Nations General Assembly in New York next week, the State Department said on Thursday, even as Washington and Tehran remain at war and continue intermittent talks aimed at ending the conflict. A State Department spokesperson said a "core delegation from the Iranian regime" would be allowed to attend the meeting in line with the United States' obligations as the world body's host country. That means officials including Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi will be granted visas, according to a source familiar with the decision. President Donald Trump's administration has held on-again, off-again talks with Iran's leaders aimed at ending the war that began on February 28 when the US and Israel attacked Iran. Tehran responded with strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases. "The delegation will be under travel restrictions and will face prohibitions on the purchase of luxury and other goods per our policy. The delegation is smaller than last year," the State Department spokesperson added. In the past, the US government has [USN:L5N3V91M8 TEXT:"barred "]Iran's delegation from shops and restricted its movements to travel between the United Nations headquarters, the Iranian UN mission and UN ambassador's residence and New York's John F Kennedy Airport. Iran's Foreign Ministry did not immediately respond to Reuters' request for comment. Under the 1947 U.N. "headquarters agreement," the United States is generally required to allow access to the United Nations for foreign diplomats. But Washington says it can deny visas for "security, terrorism and foreign policy" reasons. The Trump administration on Wednesday said it would [USN:FWN4580MT TEXT:"deny entry to Palestinian officials"] for the UN meeting, extending a ban in place since last year, over actions they took to "internationalize the Israeli-Palestinian conflict," including pursuing cases against Israel at international tribunals. Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas was denied a visa as part of the US move, a Palestinian official said.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Gerhard Mey

[カムノック（スコットランド） １７日　ロイター] - 英国のチャールズ国王は１７日、スコットランドの関連施設に主要な人工知能（ＡＩ）企業の幹部らを招き、ＡＩ技術が悪用された場合の影響に対する懸念を示した上で「手遅れになる」前に対策を講じることが必要だと訴えた。チャールズ国王はこれまでも地球規模の問題に関する議論の場を設けており、ＡＩが環境に与える影響にも警鐘を鳴らしている。

会合には、英国の担当閣僚のほか、米エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）やグーグル・ディープマインドの創業者兼会長デミス・ハサビス氏、オープンＡＩのサラ ・フライヤー最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）らが参加した。

チャールズ国王は、ＡＩには生命科学や医学などの発展に資する可能性もあるとした一方で、開発者側から人類の絶滅を招く恐れがあるとの警告が出ていることを踏まえ「存亡に関わる危険について、適切に検討することが急務のようだ」と言及した。

ＡＩを巡る議論は、アンソロピックの研究者２人が、急速に進化するＡＩ技術が近い将来、人類の絶滅を招く恐れがあると警告したことで注目を集めた。アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイＣＥＯも業界全体に開発を減速するよう促した。これに対し、特定企業の優位性を維持するためのルールづくりをする思惑含みではないか、との見方も出ている。

item.title: Ultragenyx sets $3.95 million price for rare disease gene therapy
item.description: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical said on Thursday it has set a U.S. list price of $3.95 million for its newly approved gene therapy Fayuvi, launching one of the world's most expensive drugs as a one-time treatment for a rare, fatal childhood disease.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy, Kamal Choudhury
item.content:encoded: Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical (RARE.O) said on Thursday it has set a U.S. list price of $3.95 million for its newly approved gene therapy Fayuvi, launching one of the world's most expensive drugs as a one-time treatment for a rare, fatal childhood disease. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Fayuvi for pediatric patients with Sanfilippo syndrome Type A, an inherited condition that progressively damages the brain and nervous system. The disease is caused by a deficiency of an enzyme called sulfamidase, leading to an abnormal accumulation of a complex sugar molecule known as heparan sulfate in the body and brain. This toxic buildup causes children to gradually lose cognitive, speech, and motor skills. Ultragenyx executives said on a conference call that the lifetime cost of caring for a child with the disease, who can spend years in a bedridden state, can exceed $8 million, a burden they said grows as the disease advances. J.P. Morgan analysts estimate Fayuvi could reach peak worldwide sales of $200 million to $250 million. Ultragenyx shares closed 12.6% higher on Thursday. Administered as a single intravenous infusion, the gene therapy delivers a functional copy of the SGSH gene into cells, enabling the body to produce sulfamidase and clear the damaging buildup. In trials, children treated with the therapy maintained or improved cognitive function compared with untreated patients, according to the FDA. Glenn O'Neill, president and co-founder of nonprofit Cure Sanfilippo Foundation, whose daughter Eliza was diagnosed in 2013, and treated with the therapy in 2016 at age 6, said the approval means "real hope and a real life-changing chance to have a different outcome than the traditional course of this disease." Eliza's parents told Reuters ahead of the decision that she has "never had a seizure" and is not on a feeding tube or in a wheelchair, and attends school and swims, outcomes they said far exceed what is typical for the disease. Ultragenyx expects Fayuvi to be available at specialized U.S. treatment centers within 30 to 60 days.

item.description: [１７日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースのエコノミストは１７日、イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＪＰモルガン、英中銀が27年2月に利上げと予想　従来の利下げ見通し修正 3:40 配信

米ニューヨークのＪＰモルガン・チェース本社。４月撮影。REUTERS/Eduardo Munoz

[１７日 ロイター] - 米金融大手ＪＰモルガン・チェースのエコノミストは１７日、イングランド銀行（ＢＯＥ、英中央銀行）が１１月、さらに２０２７年２月に利上げに踏み切るとの見通しを示した。従来は１１月に１回利上げした後、２７年に２回利下げすると予想していたが、これを修正した。

金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）はこの日、政策金利を３．７５％に据え置くことを６対３の賛成多数で決定した。中東紛争が長引けばさらなる金融引き締めが必要になる可能性があると警告したほか、２７年初めに英国のインフレ率が４％を超えるとの見通しも示した。

ＪＰモルガンのシニアエコノミスト、アラン・モンクス氏はリポートで、「地政学的な見通しに大きな変化がない限り、１１月の利上げについてはほぼ決定済みであるかのように聞こえる」と指摘。

モンクス氏は、１１月の利上げに続き、２７年にももう１回利上げが実施されると予想。その後は、賃金期待が４％まで上昇するといったインフレの二次的影響を示す明確な証拠が出ない限り、ＢＯＥは政策金利を据え置くとみている。

また、英中銀が金利決定と併せて発表した、今後６カ月間、国債（ギルト債）売却を全て一時停止するとの決定については、「これは市場が不安定な時期に不確実性を低減させることを目的とした、明確かつ断固とした計画だ」と評価。

一方で「ＢＯＥと政府の決定の境界線を曖昧にするという印象を伴うことを考えると、大きなサプライズだ」との見方を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 コラム：ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が問う見通しのあり方、3つの論点＝井上哲也氏 アングル：世界的な中銀の金融引き締め姿勢、米イラン合意でも潮目変わらず アングル：米イラン合意、日銀の利上げ路線変わらず　6月の次は10月予想も 最終更新: 9/18(金) 3:40 ロイター

Three pumping stations along Saudi East-West Pipeline were hit in recent attack, sources say

Satellite images showed that one more pumping station was damaged than previously thought.

A satellite image shows a closer view of the damage at the Saudi Arabia East-West pipeline, located across the Arabian Peninsula, after a strike that hit it on Sep 11, 2026, in Saudi Arabia, Sep 13, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Vantor)

CAIRO: Three pumping stations serving the vital East - West Pipeline in Saudi Arabia were damaged in an attack last week - one more than assessed previously - with a repair timeline unclear, according to sa tellite imagery and three industry sources . Saudi Aramco, which operates the 1,200km pipeline running across the Arabian Peninsula, and Saudi Arabia's government media office did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The pipeline , which has helped relieve the disruptions to flows through the Strait of Hormuz, temporarily shut down on Friday following a drone attack coming from Iraq, Saudi officials have sa id. Oil and security sources had previously indicated that two pumping stations were hit in the attack . But a Reuters analysis of sa tellite images showed damage to three stations , which was also confirmed by sources .

Sources that have spoken to Reuters have given varying estimates of how long it will take to reopen the pipeline and return crude flows to normal. Three sa id the damage could take as long as five to six weeks to repair. Another sa id it could be fixed sooner and could resume pumping partially while repairs are ongoing. The pipeline is serviced by 11 pumping stations and two separate pressure relief stations , according to industry assessments. The facility has served as the main route out for global supplies of Middle East oil for the past six months while the Strait of Hormuz has been largely shut by war. It has been moving 4 million to 5 million barrels per day, amounting to 4 per cent to 5 per cent of global supply, sparing Saudi Arabia the brunt of the disruption that has crippled other Gulf oil and gas exporters.

item.title: Amway, affiliates to pay $225 million to settle US claims they deceived recruits
item.description: Multilevel marketing company Amway Corp and two of its affiliates will pay the Federal Trade Commission and Washington State $225 million to resolve allegations it recruited new members with deceptive claims about how much money they could make, the agency said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Multilevel marketing company Amway Corp and two of its affiliates will pay the Federal Trade Commission and Washington State $225 million to resolve allegations it recruited new members with deceptive claims about how much money they could make, the agency said on Thursday. Amway and affiliates World Wide Group LLC and Leadership Team Development Inc told potential recruits that they could make $40,000 or more, according to the FTC. But most of those who joined the two affiliates after 2020 ended up spending more money on training and Amway products than they made, after they were encouraged to buy products that they did not want in order to earn compensation from Amway, the FTC said. "We fundamentally disagree with the agencies’ characterization of our business," an Amway spokesperson said, adding that Amway members are required to follow robust standards of conduct as part of their contract. The $225 million will largely go to repay Amway members affected by the conduct, the FTC said. Amway also agreed to change its practices to disincentivize members from making their primary activity being buying products themselves and recruiting others to do so, the FTC said. The FTC said the settlement is the largest in an FTC action against a multilevel marketing company.

item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's Prince Harry made his first public appearance on Thursday since he and his wife Meghan [USN:L8N44N0XA TEXT:"returned to Britain"] after six years in California, saying, "It's good to be back on British soil." Harry, the younger son of King Charles, relocated last month with Meghan and their children Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, surprising even their close family. The royal attended the inaugural Invictus Spirit Awards in London, which are linked to the Invictus Games, the sporting competition for wounded, injured and sick military veterans that he founded. Earlier, Harry spoke at an event focused on improving the care of children wounded in conflict hosted by charity Save the Children and Imperial College London. His appearances came on a [USN:L8N4590QP TEXT:"busy day for Britain's royals"], with Charles hosting a [USN:L1N4590CK TEXT:"conference for AI leaders"] amid [USN:L8N4581JE TEXT:"criticism"] in a forthcoming book by the brother of his late first wife, Diana. The book by Charles Spencer is being serialised in the Daily Mail. In the latest extracts published on Thursday, [USN:L8N4591RV TEXT:"Spencer said"] King Charles sounded "like a lottery winner" after the death of Diana.

item.title: Trump says progress made toward establishing US Army base in Poland
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Thursday that progress is being made toward establishing a US Army base in Poland, crediting "the bold leadership" of Polish President Karol Nawrocki.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Thursday that progress is being made toward establishing a US Army base in Poland, crediting "the bold leadership" of Polish President Karol Nawrocki. "If this happens, the location will be announced very soon. This will be a historic step for our Great U.S./Polish Alliance," Trump said in a post on Truth Social. Nawrocki later thanked Trump on X, saying that Poland was "ready to continue our efforts to strengthen our defense cooperation," and adding: "I can assure you that the Polish government will do its utmost to provide the best possible location for the US Army base." The head of the Polish president's chancellery, Zbigniew Bogucki, called it "great news for Poland," underscoring that it came on the 87th anniversary of Soviet Russia's invasion of Poland. Poland has been pushing for a bigger allied presence on NATO's eastern flank after Russia's invasion of neighboring Ukraine in 2022. In June, Polish Defense Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz [USN:L8N42Q124 TEXT:"said"] the US Department of Defense was open to Poland's offer to host a permanent US military presence in Poland, but that no decision had been taken. The minister met with US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in June in Brussels, where the Pentagon chief announced a new review of US troop deployments in Europe. Poland has so far hosted US troops on a rotational basis.

item.title: Trump dice que se han logrado avances para establecer una base del Ejército de EEUU en Polonia
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el jueves que se están logrando progresos para establecer una base del Ejército de Estados Unidos en Polonia, y atribuyó el mérito al "audaz liderazgo" del mandatario polaco Karol Nawrocki.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump dijo el jueves que se están logrando progresos para establecer una base del Ejército de Estados Unidos en Polonia, y atribuyó el mérito al "audaz liderazgo" del mandatario polaco Karol Nawrocki. "Si esto se hace realidad, la ubicación se anunciará muy pronto. Será un paso histórico para nuestra gran alianza entre EEUU y Polonia", dijo Trump en una publicación en Truth Social. Más tarde, Nawrocki agradeció a Trump a través de X, afirmando que Polonia estaba "lista para continuar nuestros esfuerzos por fortalecer la cooperación en materia de defensa". Agregó que "puedo asegurarles que el gobierno polaco hará todo lo posible para ofrecer la mejor ubicación posible para la base del Ejército de Estados Unidos". El jefe de la cancillería presidencial polaca, Zbigniew Bogucki, calificó la noticia de "magnífica para Polonia", subrayando que se producía en el 87.º aniversario de la invasión de Polonia por parte de la Rusia soviética. Polonia ha estado presionando para lograr una mayor presencia aliada en el flanco oriental de la OTAN tras la invasión rusa de la vecina Ucrania en 2022. En junio, el ministro de Defensa polaco, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, dijo que el Departamento de Defensa de Estados Unidos se mostraba receptivo a la oferta de Polonia de albergar una presencia militar estadounidense permanente en el país, aunque señaló que aún no se había tomado ninguna decisión. El ministro se reunió en junio en Bruselas con el secretario de Defensa de Estados Unidos, Pete Hegseth, ocasión en la que el jefe del Pentágono anunció una nueva revisión del despliegue de tropas estadounidenses en Europa. Hasta la fecha, Polonia ha acogido tropas estadounidenses bajo un régimen de rotación.

item.title: The Case for AI Guardrails Without a Slowdown
item.description: AI is helping companies build faster, but as competition at the frontier intensifies, should there be limits on how much risk companies can take to stay ahead? Karen McCormick, chief investment officer at Beringea, argues the answer isn't slowing innovation, but establishing common guardrails around testing, cybersecurity, and incident reporting. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: AI’s Safety Debate Meets Silicon Valley FOMO
item.description: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down OpenAI's new plan to track when things go wrong after revealing new cases of its AI models going off-script. Plus, Databricks CEO Ali Ghodsi and machine learning pioneer Andrew Ng weigh in on the global AI safety debate. Meanwhile in Silicon Valley, the immediate fear is missing out on the money. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Knicks Halt Ticket Sales After Error Sends Prices Over $1,200
item.description: The New York Knicks suspended individual ticket sales after an internal error resulted in sky-high prices to see the NBA champions play their season opener in October.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Miller

item.title: AI Extinction Fears Are ‘Science Fiction’: Andrew Ng
item.description: AI pioneer Andrew Ng is pushing back against renewed warnings that increasingly powerful models could pose an existential threat to humanity, calling those fears “much more science fiction than science.” He argues that AI systems will never be perfectly predictable, but that testing, safeguards, and engineering, can make them safer over time. He also warns that broadly slowing AI development could also slow progress on safety. He joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: 【欧州市況】株上昇、7月上旬来の大幅高－英30年債利回りは大幅低下
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 17日の欧州株は大幅上昇。7月上旬以来の大幅高となった。米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）の利上げを受け、市場はインフレ抑制に取り組む米金融当局の姿勢を前向きに受け止めた。イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）は市場の予想通り、政策金利を据え置いた。

ストックス欧州600指数は0.9%上昇。業種別では基礎資源、自動車関連銘柄がアウトパフォームした。一方、化学やパーソナルケア株は下落した。

欧州債市場では英国債が続伸。パフォーマンスはドイツ債や米国債を上回った。英中銀が量的引き締め（QT）に伴う国債売却を2027年4月まで全面的に停止するほか、長期債の売却計画を撤回したことが好感された。

英30年債利回りは12ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）低下して5.74%。下げ幅は5月20日以降で最大だった。

5年債と30年債のスプレッドは8bp縮小して93bpと、終値ベースで2025年3月以降で最も小幅となった。

英中銀の利上げ観測は後退。トレーダーは11月に22bp、年末までに39bpと織り込む。前日はそれぞれ28bpと44bpだった。スワップ市場によれば、来年半ばまでにあと4回の利上げが想定されている。

ドイツ債はツイストフラット化。トレーダーによる欧州中央銀行（ECB）の利上げ観測は総じて変わらず。年末までに36bp、来年末までは81bpと織り込まれている。

原題：European Stocks Bounce as US Bond Yields Ease; Raiffeisen Drops

Gilts Bull Flatten After BOE Makes QT Changes: End-of-Day Curves

item.title: メタと契約のデータセンター運営会社、ジャンク債で約3500億円調達へ
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： メタ・プラットフォームズ向けのAIデータセンター運営を手がけるクリーンスパークは、インフラ整備の資金を調達するため、初のジャンク債を発行し、約22億3000万ドル（約3500億円）を調達しようとしている。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、当初の条件提示では、発行する5年債の利回りは約8.5%で、ブルームバーグが追跡する「BB」格企業の発行債の平均を約2ポイント上回る。投資家がデータセンター向け融資に、より高い上乗せ金利を求めていることが背景にある。

関係者によると、17日の起債時点で、投資家からは発行額とほぼ同規模の注文が入っていた。別の関係者によると、この案件は、モルガン・スタンレーが主幹事を務めている。18日には条件が決定する見通しだ。ゴールドマン・サックス・グループとウェルズ・ファーゴも引受会社として参加している。

規制当局への提出資料によると、調達資金は米ジョージア州サンダースビルのデータセンター建設費に充てられる。ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、メタのデータセンターに関連するジャンク債の発行は今回が初めて。

クリーンスパークの資料によると、このデータセンターはメタの子会社アンビランが、総額66億ドル、20年間の契約で全て賃貸する。データセンターは2027年10－12月期に稼働し始める見通しで、メタが賃料と運営費を保証するという。

クリーンスパークはジャンク級の格付けだが、メタとの契約により、予測可能な収入源を確保し、多額の費用を要するプロジェクト向けの借り入れができる。ブルームバーグがまとめたデータによると、データセンター開発会社は今年これまでに計約390億ドルのハイイールド債を発行しており、その大半はオラクルやアマゾン・ドット・コムなどのハイパースケーラーとの長期賃貸契約を裏付けとしている。

クリーンスパークとモルガン・スタンレーはコメントの要請に直ちに応じなかった。メタはコメントを控えた。

item.title: GM doubles down on diesel pickups as rivals tap hybrids
item.description: General Motors is sticking with a diesel engine to maximize fuel efficiency as it rolls out a next-generation pickup truck, diverging from rivals’ hybrid offerings.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Staff
item.content:encoded: General Motors is sticking with a diesel engine to maximize fuel efficiency as it rolls out a next-generation pickup truck, diverging from rivals’ hybrid offerings. GM plans in the fourth quarter to launch the first major redesign since 2019 of its most important vehicles: the Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra pickup trucks. Combined, they are the Detroit automaker’s top-selling models globally and account for the bulk of the company’s profits. To boost fuel economy, GM said Thursday that the trucks will offer an improved diesel engine that, combined with an optional larger fuel tank, will deliver a highway driving range of more than 900 miles before needing a fill-up. GM’s main competitors in light-duty pickup trucks, Ford F.N and Ram-maker Stellantis STLAM.MI, are relying on hybrids to wring the most fuel efficiency from their pickups. GM has largely sidestepped hybrids over the years. “It’s a bit different than adding a hybrid system to an existing powertrain and trying to get the efficiency out of something like that,” GM President Mark Reuss said of the 3.0-liter diesel engine during a media briefing. Reuss acknowledged high diesel prices, which topped $6 per gallon last week, an all-time high. He drew a distinction between temporary price spikes from geopolitical events and structural increases, and said GM is betting on the superior efficiency of diesels in the long run. Ford early this decade discontinued a diesel engine on its F-150 in favor of a hybrid model, which it said offered a better combination of power and fuel efficiency. A spokesman said Thursday: “We’re going to do what’s right for F-150 customers, regardless of what the competition says or does.” Diesels have better MPG, higher prices GM’s redesign of the Silverado and Sierra unofficially marks the next phase of Detroit’s long-running battle in the pickup-truck market. Ford is expected to roll out the next generation of its F-150 in 2028, forecasters say. GM, Ford and Stellantis account for more than 90% of sales in the lucrative U.S. market for big pickups, and compete fiercely for bragging rights on performance metrics like towing capacity and fuel economy. Diesel engines generally provide better highway fuel efficiency than gas engines, which is why large cargo trucks typically use diesels. Each of the Detroit companies offer diesels in their larger, heavy-duty pickups, such as Ford’s Super Duty and the Ram 2500. But their approaches have diverged on their light-duty trucks: Ford’s F-150, the Silverado and Sierra and Ram’s 1500. Ford’s four-wheel drive hybrid gets 23 miles per gallon on average, according to its federal rating. GM’s current four-wheel-drive diesel versions of its Silverado and Sierra get 24 mpg. However, because diesel prices typically are higher than gas, owners of the GM trucks would pay about $1,050 per year, based on 15,000 miles driven, the federal estimate shows. Ram has plans for a so-called extended-range hybrid pickup truck, a type of plug-in hybrid that it says will get 690 miles between stops. GM also said the redesigned Silverado and Sierra trucks will have two new V-8 engines that will be larger and more powerful than the outgoing ones, with lower tailpipe emissions. (Reporting by Kalea Hall in Flint, Mich.; Editing by Mike Colias and Nick Zieminski)

item.description:
Jody Godoy
[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - 米司法省の反トラスト当局者は１７日、人工知能（ＡＩ）の...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩ安全性巡る企業間連携、反競争的とみなさず＝米司法省高官 2:10 配信

6月5日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

Jody Godoy

[ニューヨーク １７日 ロイター] - 米司法省の反トラスト当局者は１７日、人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性を巡る競合企業間の協力について、反競争的とはみなしていないとの認識を示した。

同省の反トラスト部門を率いるウッドワード司法次官補は、「サイバーセキュリティーや安全保障に関する連携が反競争的だとは思わない」と述べた。

また、反トラスト部門は企業との協議に前向きな姿勢を示した上で、これまでのところＡＩ研究機関から反トラスト法（独占禁止法） を巡る懸念に関する会合の要請は受けていないと明らかにした。

ＡＩの安全性を巡る議論が活発化する中、アンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は先週、競合企業がＡＩ開発ペースの抑制に向けた調整を行えるよう、独占禁止法上の適用除外措置を認めるべきだと訴えた。

こうした中、ＡＩ新興企業のオープンＡＩは、ＡＩの安全性向上に向け、競合するアンソロピックやアルファベット傘下のグーグル・ディープマインドと協力していることを明らかにした。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＡＩで相互依存強める新興企業と巨大ＩＴ コラム：ＡＩ企業の膨らむコスト負担、高品質データで争奪戦 アングル：クック氏からターナス氏へ、アップル新体制にＡＩと「脱中国」の試練 アングル：中銀の政策運営、ＡＩ普及で「ディストピア」に直面の恐れ　研究者が警鐘 アングル：世界市場が当面向き合う6つのリスク、地政学や金融政策・ＡＩなど 最終更新: 9/18(金) 2:10 ロイター

item.title: 'I'm Russian,' Ovechkin says about decision to appear in ad for Putin-backed United Russia
item.description: Alexander Ovechkin said on Thursday that he agreed to appear in a political campaign advertisement for the United Russia party, which is backed by President Vladimir Putin, because he supports his country.
item.dc:creator: Brad Ulery
item.content:encoded: Alexander Ovechkin said on Thursday that he agreed to appear in a political campaign advertisement for the United Russia party, which is backed by President Vladimir Putin, because he supports his country. "I'm Russian, and I support my country," Ovechkin, the NHL's all-time leading goalscorer, told reporters at the Washington Capitals' media day. "I'm for peace and love, and I hope in the world it doesn't matter who you are, I hope everybody understands, everybody wants peace and everybody hope everything is going to be okay in the world." Russia will hold a parliamentary election from September 18 to 20, the first since it launched its full-scale war in Ukraine in February 2022. Ovechkin, who can be seen standing behind Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov in the video, said he was asked to participate and did not hesitate to agree. He added that he will live in Russia following the end of his career. "As soon as I'm done playing hockey, I'm probably going to stay there," he said. "I'm gonna live there, my kids gonna live there, family. I'm for peace and love and I hope everything's going to be okay." Ovechkin has faced scrutiny over his longstanding ties to Putin as Russia wages war in Ukraine. In 2017 he formed a [USN:KBN1D22LC TEXT:"public movement"] in support of Putin and his Instagram profile picture is a photo of him and the Russian president. He [USN:L1N2V03AT TEXT:"called for peace"] in February 2022 following his home country's invasion of Ukraine. When asked about his support for Putin at the time, he said, "Well, he is my president. But ... I am not in politics. I am an athlete and ... I hope everything is going to be done soon." Ovechkin, who turned 41 on Thursday, has scored 929 goals in 1,573 regular-season NHL games and the upcoming season will be his 22nd in the league. He led the Capitals to a Stanley Cup in 2018.

item.title: 米中古住宅仮契約指数、8月は0.3％上昇 予想外の増加
item.description: [ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１７日発表した８月の米中古住宅販売仮契約指数は前月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米中古住宅仮契約指数、8月は0.3％上昇　予想外の増加 1:36 配信

2022年7月7日、米国ワシントンで撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Silbiger

[ワシントン １７日 ロイター] - 全米リアルター協会（ＮＡＲ）が１７日発表した８月の米中古住宅販売仮契約指数は前月比で０．３％上昇の７１．２となった。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（０．６％低下）に反し増加した。

ただ、住宅ローン金利の高止まりが一部の購入希望者を市場から遠ざけ、住宅需要を圧迫し続けているため、この増加は一時的なものにとどまる公算が大きい。

前年比では４．７％低下。地域別では南部と西部で増加した一方、北東部と中西部で低下した。

イランとの戦争を背景としたインフレや、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の対応を巡る不透明感で米長期国債利回りが急伸し、住宅ローン金利は８月も高止まりが続いた。

ＦＲＢは１６日、２０２３年７月以来となる利上げに踏み切った。米住宅金融公社フレディマックのデータによると、３０年固定住宅ローン金利は先週、平均６．７６％と、前週の６．７１％から上昇し、１年余りぶりの高水準を付けた。

ＮＡＲのチーフエコノミスト、ローレンス・ユン氏は「全国的に見ると、現在の契約件数はパンデミックに至るまでの数年間の水準を約３０％下回っている」と指摘。「取引活動は住宅ローン金利が歴史的低水準である３％近くまで低下した２０２１年にピークを付けたが、それ以降その水準には近づいていない」と述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 焦点：投資家の信頼高める米ＦＲＢ、「タカ派姿勢の見せ過ぎ」に不安も アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 最終更新: 9/18(金) 1:36 ロイター

Sept 17 : Cloud provider Nebius said on Thursday it will raise pay-as-you-go prices for leasing selected Nvidia chips from October 1, marking the company's second price hike in three months. Demand for computing capacity to train and run AI models is surging; rival CoreWeave said earlier in the day that it is signing contracts at higher prices. Here are some details: • Rates for selected Nvidia graphics processing units will rise between 17 per cent and 21 per cent.

FAST

LONDON, Sept 17 : The British government's refusal to confirm whether it has issued an order to bypass encryption to access customer data held by Apple has become farcical, a lawyer for civil rights groups told a London tribunal on Thursday. In January last year, Britain issued an order, known as a technical capability notice, for what is known as a back door to allow it access to encrypted cloud backups of data of U.S. and British citizens. That demand was dropped following months of negotiations with U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, but in July Britain issued a second notice that applied just to Apple's UK customers. The issue has been clouded in secrecy as the British government says it cannot comment on the existence of individual TCNs because it operates a policy of neither confirm nor deny on security matters.

APPLE AND CAMPAIGN GROUPS HAVE BOTH TAKEN ACTION Apple has launched a challenge at a specialist court, the Investigatory Powers Tribunal, but has been unable to give public details on why because of legal restrictions. Campaign groups have also taken action over the order, which they say would violate human rights and weaken security, even though the government refuses to confirm the TCN exists. At Thursday's hearing at the IPT, Ben Jaffey, the lawyer for campaign groups, Privacy International and Liberty, said the government's position had "become farcical". "The horse has long bolted," he noted, meaning it was already public knowledge. U.S. politicians and officials had publicly referred to the original notice while unnamed UK government sources had also confirmed it to the press, he said.  Both he and Apple's lawyer said that the UK government's NCND policy was an affront to open justice and prevented meaningful public discussion of the issue.      The British government's lawyer Neil Sheldon said the issue went beyond the arguments in the Apple case. Any move away from the policy posed a national security risk and "would provide material assistance to hostile actors" who would be able to build a picture of which operators were subject to TCNs, he said. The IPT will give a ruling on the NCND issue at a later date while a full hearing on the case itself is unlikely until next year.    Apple, which itself has no access to the encrypted data of those who make use of its Advanced Data Protection feature on their devices, including iPhones and Mac computers, has said that if it creates an entry point for one government, that could be exploited by hackers or hostile states, weakening security for all. Following Britain's demands, Apple withdrew its Advanced Data Protection feature for UK users in February last year, saying it would never build a back door.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 英保険業界、危機対応テストの緩和要請 「過度な負担」の声
item.description:
Phoebe Seers Annabel Tinson
[ロンドン １７日 ロイター] - 英保険業界がイングランド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英保険業界、危機対応テストの緩和要請　「過度な負担」の声 0:59 配信

2026年9月16日、英国ロンドンのイングランド銀行　REUTERS/Corey Rudy

Phoebe Seers　Annabel Tinson

[ロンドン １７日 ロイター] -  英保険業界がイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）に対し、規制部門が運用している危機対応テストの見直しを求めている。業界からは、実際には短期間に集中して発生する可能性が極めて低い想定だったため、テストへの対応が「過度な負担になる」との声が出ている。

健全性規制機構（ＰＲＡ）は今年５月、３週間にわたって初の危機対応テスト「ＤｙＧＩＳＴ」を実施。英損害保険市場の約８割の企業が対象に選定された。テストでは、米西海岸の地震や英国の暴風、欧州での洪水、サイバー攻撃といった危機への対処力が試された。シナリオは事前には示されず、即応力が求められる内容だったという。

このテストに関し、英業界団体、国際保険引受協会（ＩＵＡ）の幹部は「これほど短期間にシナリオが集中して発生する可能性は極めて低い」と指摘。業界関係者によると、予想を上回るシナリオだったことで、技術専門家を急きょ招集したり、社員の休暇を取り消したりした企業もあったという。保険業界はＰＲＡに対し、テストが多大な負担を生んだと表明。同様のテストを定期的に実施することは「負担が大き過ぎる」との懸念が出ているという。

ＰＲＡは「従来のストレステストを超えた領域を調べるよう設計された」と説明しており、年末までに調査結果を公表する予定にしている。業界の一部には、危機対応力を試すテストを支持する声もある。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：エルニーニョでも巨額損失の恐れ、保険業界がハリケーンリスク再評価 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し コラム：サイバー攻撃のリスク、顧客だけでなく保険業界も動揺 最終更新: 9/18(金) 0:59 ロイター

New cat species identified in Bolivia, first in over a century

A Leopardus tilcayo cat, a newly identified species through research led by National Geographic Explorer Paola Nogales Ascarrunz, walks at the Senda Verde animal refuge in the Yungas region, Bolivia, September 1, 2026. Fernando Faciole/National Geographic/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

Sept 17 : A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia's cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living cat species has been formally named and described in more than a century.  The cat, called Tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger cats found across much of South America. It was found in Bolivia's lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity, according to researchers. It measures about 18 inches (46 cm) long and weighs around 3 pounds (1.4 kg), making it smaller than the average domestic cat. Researchers used genetic data to confirm that the cat is a new species, and gave it the scientific name Leopardus tilcayo, retaining its local name.  "Its fur is light brown ... with irregularly shaped rosettes across its body," said Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, a National Geographic Explorer and one of the authors of the study describing the newly identified species published on Thursday in the journal Current Biology.

Little is yet known about the cat's biology and lifestyle. Remains of small rodents in scat samples suggest they may form part of its diet, while camera-trap evidence indicates it could be more active at night, Nogales-Ascarrunz said. Tiger cats are so-called cryptic species, meaning they cannot easily be distinguished merely by appearance, said evolutionary biologist and study co-lead author Jonas Lescroart of the University of Antwerp in Belgium. Tiger cats previously had been considered a single species, but genetic studies decades ago suggested the existence of multiple species.  Referring to the new species, Lescroart said, "Our information at this moment is limited to the two live individuals that we examined, and a small number of camera-trap records." One of the live cats is a 10-year-old male that now lives in Senda Verde Wildlife Sanctuary after being kept by a local family in their home.  'A DIFFERENT ANIMAL' Observing the Bolivian cat drew interest because "its characteristics did not match the descriptions, most of them based on Brazilian cats," Nogales-Ascarrunz said. "This made us wonder: what tiger cat do we actually have in Bolivia?" The team analysed DNA from 38 cats sampled across several South American countries, including eight museum specimens. The study found that tiger cats are in fact five genetically distinct species.  "We never expected this Bolivian tiger cat to be a separate species, and no one had ever proposed it as a different animal, subspecies or otherwise," Lescroart said.  Genetic analysis suggested that the Tilcayo lineage separated from other tiger cats about 1.4 million years ago. "The more differences in their DNA, the longer the time that we estimate those lineages to have been physically separated," Lescroart said, adding that such a gap is generally considered a species-level divide in cats. The research team also described a new tiger cat subspecies in Peru's Yungas, naming it Leopardus tigrinus antisuyo after Antisuyu, the region of the old Inca Empire that included the area it inhabits. The International Union for Conservation of Nature, or IUCN, Red List tracking the status of species currently treats tiger cats as two "vulnerable" species with declining populations.  The researchers have shared their findings with the IUCN, whose upcoming review will assess the five lineages separately. That could give a more accurate picture of risk, Lescroart said, and species such as the Tilcayo could potentially be considered endangered when assessed on their own.  The need for a clearer assessment is particularly acute in the Yungas, one of the region's most threatened ecosystems.  The mountain forests face growing pressure from deforestation, agricultural expansion, human-caused fires and mining, Nogales-Ascarrunz said. Restoring forest patches damaged by fires, protecting remaining native forest and maintaining connections between habitats are urgent priorities, Nogales-Ascarrunz added.  "Showing the general public that even in a flagship group such as cats ... there are still new species to be discovered may transmit an important message," said Eduardo Eizirik, an evolutionary biologist at the Pontifical Catholic University of Rio Grande do Sul in Brazil and senior author of the study. "There are many undiscovered species out there in the world, and they are at risk of disappearing before we even discover them."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Latam markets inch higher in global risk-on mood after Fed hike
item.description: Most Latin American stocks and currencies rose on Thursday, lifted by a global risk-on mood as Treasury yields and the dollar eased after the Federal Reserve's latest rate hike reinforced its resolve to contain inflation.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Ragini Mathur
item.content:encoded: Most Latin American stocks and currencies rose on Thursday, lifted by a global risk-on mood as Treasury yields and the dollar eased after the Federal Reserve's latest rate hike reinforced its resolve to contain inflation. MSCI's index tracking regional stocks (.MILA00000PUS) edged higher by 0.6%. With Brazil's presidential elections fast approaching, market focus remained pinned on the contest. An [USN:S8N44200N TEXT:"AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll"] showed Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva remain statistically tied in a simulated runoff ahead of next month's vote. Surveys lately continue to point towards a neck-and-neck race, with market sentiment influenced by shifts in the electoral odds. Against this backdrop, President Lula [USN:L1N4590JP TEXT:"announced a 15% increase"] in cash transfers under the country's flagship welfare program, Bolsa Familia, to shore up his support ahead of the election. The program could add to investor anxiety over the deteriorating public finances under the current government. "Of course, investors associate Bolsonaro with a more fiscally prudent and market-friendly policy agenda," Luca Bindelli, head of investment strategy at Lombard Odier, said. "I don't think Lula's potential win would be outright negative, but it would likely not lead to gains as strong as those under a Bolsonaro victory." On the monetary policy front, Brazil's central bank on Wednesday [USN:L6N458186 TEXT:"cut interest rates by 25 basis points"] for a fifth straight meeting amid firmer signs of an economic slowdown while keeping its options open ahead of the election. "After a series of weaker economic growth data, we think this should help soothe sentiment," Bindelli said. The benchmark Ibovespa index (.BVSP) added 0.5%, while the real inched 0.3% higher. Across the broader currency space, MSCI's index of Latin American currencies (.MILA00000CUS) dipped 0.06%. The U.S. dollar was down 0.05% after touching seven-week highs, while U.S. Treasury yields fell as investors digested the Federal Reserve's widely anticipated rate hike and policymakers' signals of further tightening. Analysts said markets took comfort from the removal of immediate uncertainty around the Fed's decision, despite its hawkish tone. The global inflation outlook remained uncertain this year, mainly due to the ongoing Middle East conflict. Potential trade-related disruptions and persistently high energy prices are keeping central banks cautious. Elsewhere in the region, Politica reported that US President Donald Trump and Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum spoke by phone on Wednesday as the [USN:FWN4590VF TEXT:"two countries close in on a trade agreement"]. The Mexican peso gained 0.4%, after hitting an over-one-month low of 17.2710 a dollar in the prior session. Mexico's benchmark stock index (.MXX) rose 0.5%, as trading resumed following a holiday on Wednesday. [USN:L1N4590VL TEXT:"Argentina's economy grew 2.0%"] in the second quarter from a year earlier, beating analyst expectations as mining, agriculture and exports helped support economic activity. The unemployment rate [USN:S0N3VJ05D TEXT:"reached 7.9% in the second quarter"] of 2026, rising from the 7.6% registered in the same period a year earlier. Argentina's stock index (.MERV) gained 1.2%, while the country's currency was up 0.3%. item.title: US Senate panel sets hearing for Trump's FDA pick
item.description: The U.S. Senate health committee will hold a confirmation hearing next week for Dr. Heidi Overton, President Donald Trump's pick to lead the embattled Food and Drug Administration, the panel said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Aboulenein
item.content:encoded: The U.S. Senate health committee will hold a confirmation hearing next week for Dr. Heidi Overton, President Donald Trump's pick to lead the embattled Food and Drug Administration, the panel said on Thursday. The hearing will take place on September 24, the Senate Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee said in a statement. Trump nominated Overton, a White House policy aide, in August, turning to an "America First" ally to steady an agency shaken by staff losses, low morale and fights over vaccines, the abortion pill and drug approvals. If the Senate confirms her, Overton will take over an FDA that has lost more than 3,000 staff over the past year, including division heads, and is under pressure to rebuild confidence among industry and public-health groups. The agency, which is responsible for regulating and approving all drugs, treatments and vaccines, has faced concerns it has become too political. Trump's previous FDA commissioner, Marty Makary, resigned in May after 13 months in the job following clashes with White House officials over flavored vapes, a stalled abortion-pill safety study and public disagreements with drugmakers such as Replimune, Sarepta and Moderna over reviews of potentially lifesaving medicines and vaccines. Overton, a preventive medicine physician by training who serves as deputy director of the White House Domestic Policy Council, previously worked at the America First Policy Institute, a conservative think tank. Her nomination coincides with new efforts by Trump health officials to take action on a number of controversial issues, including autism and vaccines as well as the abortion pill. She spoke at a White House event last month at which Trump signed a new executive order calling for significantly cutting back the national childhood vaccination schedule and splitting the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine into three separate shots, a move physicians and vaccine makers swiftly rejected. The administration is tackling a backlog of health vacancies across government. The Senate confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz to lead the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention last month, and Senate panels have held confirmation hearings this week for other vacant top posts including deputy health secretary and surgeon general.

item.title: アマゾン、ＡＩ安全対策を重視 開発ペース鈍化論には慎重
item.description:
Greg Bensinger
[サンフランシスコ １７日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは、人工知能（ＡＩ）...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アマゾン、ＡＩ安全対策を重視　開発ペース鈍化論には慎重 0:42 配信

2025年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Greg Bensinger

[サンフランシスコ １７日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムは、人工知能（ＡＩ）の安全性について、ＡＩモデルは安全性が確保され、十分な試験を経た上でリリースされるべきだとの考えを示した。ただ、ＡＩ業界全体での開発ペース鈍化を求めるには至らなかった。

アマゾンの広報担当者はロイターに対し、「われわれは『進歩』と『安全性』の二者択一だとは考えていない」と述べた。

その上で、「ＡＩモデルは、準備が整い、安全に利用できる状態になってからリリースされるべきであり、それは厳格な試験と強固な安全対策によって実現される」と強調。「業界全体がそれを実践しなければリスクが生じる」と警告した。

さらに、「業界として政府と連携し、適切な保護策を講じていく」とした。

ＡＩがもたらす潜在的リスクを巡っては、米アンソロピックの研究者２人が先週、ＡＩの急速な進歩によって、そう遠くない将来に「人類滅亡」につながる可能性があると警告。これを受け、ＡＩの安全性を巡る議論が活発化している。

アンソロピック、オープンＡＩ、ｘＡＩ、アルファベット傘下グーグルのグーグル・ディープマインド、マイクロソフトの首脳らは、ＡＩ開発を巡りより慎重なアプローチを支持するスタンスで一致し、安全性を最優先事項とするよう協力していくことで合意している。

アマゾンは、同様の取り組みを講じる計画があるかどうかについては言及しなかった。

India’s Tier-2, 3 cities see a 95% rise in IT jobs. Hiring is shifting beyond metros

Xpheno’s job outlook data shows that while full-time IT jobs have increased only by 10%, internships and part-time jobs have recorded a staggering 90% growth.

Aakriti Handa

17 September, 2026 09:01 pm IST

Facebook

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

New Delhi: More than 41,000 IT jobs are set to open up in September in India’s Tier-II and Tier-III cities, according to the Active Tech Jobs Outlook shared by talent solutions firm Xpheno.

It forecasts a recovery in the IT services job market, with over 57,000 active open jobs in September. This has also pulled up the jobs demand in the IT sector to over 1,17,000 this month, marking an increase of 15 per cent from the talent demand recorded in September last year.

On closer look, Xpheno’s job outlook data shows that while full-time jobs have increased only by 10 per cent, internships and part-time jobs have recorded a staggering 90 per cent growth.

Show Full Article

In addition, Global Capability Centres (GCCs) have recorded a 38 per cent increase year-on-year in job openings, with nearly 13,000 active jobs; while tech functions in the Big 4/Big10 have recorded a 68 per cent increase, with 5,000 active jobs.

Also read: Who is Robert Kraft? The billionaire who removed Macklemore from Ed Sheeran’s tour

Dip in metro numbers As far as locations are concerned, major IT hubs including Bengaluru and Hyderabad have recorded a fall in the number of active jobs by 15 per cent and 8 per cent year-on-year respectively. In addition, IT jobs have fallen by nearly 30 per cent in Chennai. However, Tier-II and Tier-III cities have emerged as new centres for active IT jobs, registering a 95 per cent increase over the last year.

The report also noted that while Work From Office jobs have recorded a 26 per cent growth, full-time remote and hybrid jobs have reduced by 21 per cent and 7 per cent respectively over the last 12 months.

The Active Tech Jobs Outlook Report monitors the job market monthly and curates active job openings directly published by employers. It considers active jobs as opportunities that are published, refreshed, kept active and accepting applications for the report period concerned.

The active job postings are tracked and curated from companies’ career pages, official job pages on prominent social media and direct postings on top job boards. The active jobs count does not include hiring mandates and job openings that are published by and through recruitment and staffing agencies.

(Edited by Ratan Priya)

item.title: ハッカーのブロックチェーン利用440%増、オープンソースAIで攻撃拡大
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： オープンソースのAIによって、ハッカーがブロックチェーン上に悪意のあるコードを隠すことが容易になっており、サイバー犯罪の増加にすでに直面する暗号資産業界に新たな脅威が生じている。

ブロックチェーン分析会社チェイナリシスが17日公表したリポートによると、オンチェーン取引やスマートコントラクトにマルウェアの指示が書き込まれた事例は1年足らずで440%増加し、1日平均11件となった。悪意のあるコードの生成に制限を設けていない高性能な中国製オープンソースAIモデルが昨年半ばに公開される以前は、こうした事例は1日平均2件だったという。

マルウェア攻撃では、コンピューターやネットワークに仕込んだ悪意のあるソフトウエアを使い、情報やパスワード、資金を盗み取る。リポートで確認された攻撃では、ハッカーがブロックチェーン上にそのソフトウエアに対する指示を残し、情報の送信先を指定する「ブロックチェーン・デッドドロップ」と呼ばれる手法を用いている。ブロックチェーンに記録された情報は簡単には削除できないため、攻撃を阻止することが難しくなる可能性がある。

リポートによると、北朝鮮やイランと関係する組織を含む国家支援型のグループが現在、こうした活動の大半を占めている。

今回の調査結果は、生成AIがソフトウエアの脆弱性をより多く見つけ出し、サイバー犯罪者による攻撃の拡大を可能にすることで、サイバー脅威の急増に拍車をかけていることを示す新たな証拠となった。ブロックチェーン情報会社TRMラボによると、暗号資産分野では今年上期のハッキング件数が約150%増の207件となった。

チェイナリシスの調査責任者、エリック・ジャーディン氏は電子メールでの質問に対し、端末への最初の感染にブロックチェーンが関与することは通常なく、サプライチェーン攻撃や悪意のあるダウンロードといった従来の手段で感染するケースが多いと説明した。同社は、攻撃が成功した件数や被害額については追跡していない。

item.title: Monedas cierran mixtas en escenario de debilidad del dólar tras alza de tasas de Fed
item.description: Las principales monedas de América Latina tuvieron un desempeño dispar el jueves en un contexto de ligero retroceso del dólar frente al euro, un día después de que la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed) anunció un esperado recorte de sus tasas de interés.
item.dc:creator: Froilan Romero
item.content:encoded: Las principales monedas de América Latina tuvieron un desempeño dispar el jueves en un contexto de ligero retroceso del dólar frente al euro, un día después de que la Reserva Federal de Estados Unidos (Fed) anunció un esperado recorte de sus tasas de interés. * [USN:L6N4590ON TEXT:"El dólar había tocado el jueves"] un máximo de siete semanas después de que la Reserva Federal subió las tasas de interés y reafirmó su compromiso de frenar la inflación, aunque posteriormente caía al prolongarse el descenso de los precios de la energía ante la disminución de los temores a interrupciones en el suministro. * La Fed subió las tasas y señaló nuevas alzas, y su presidente, Kevin Warsh, reafirmó la independencia del banco central a pesar de las reiteradas peticiones del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, de reducir los costos de financiación. * El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde ante una canasta de seis importantes monedas, se tomaba un respiro y cotizaba estable, tras tocar en la víspera su máximo desde fines de julio luego del anunció de la Fed. * El Departamento de Trabajo reportó el jueves que el número de estadounidenses que solicitó prestaciones por desempleo descendió de forma inesperada la semana pasada, aunque es probable que la baja exagere la solidez del mercado laboral. * El jefe de la Fed destacó al mercado laboral como "un indicio fundamental de fortaleza" y añadió que las autoridades monetarias consideran "que la tasa de desempleo se está comportando, en esencia, de acuerdo con el pleno empleo". * El peso mexicano cotizaba cerca del cierre en 17,1650 por dólar, con una ganancia del 0,45%, favorecido por un retroceso global del dólar desde máximos de siete semanas, a medida que una caída de los precios del petróleo impulsaba el apetito por activos de riesgo. * Los precios del crudo disminuían por reportes de que Arabia Saudita ofrecería más cargamentos de petróleo a través de Omán, lo que aliviaba preocupaciones sobre el suministro. Sin embargo, la cotización se mantenían por encima de los 100 dólares por barril. * El principal índice accionario S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , que integran las 35 empresas más líquidas del mercado mexicano, avanzaba un 0,62%, a 63.887,48 unidades, en su regreso a las negociaciones tras un feriado local, mientras los inversionistas asimilaban la decisión de la Reserva Federal de elevar las tasas de interés. * El real brasileño se apreció un 0,25%, a 5,1392 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice Bovespa (.BVSP) de la bolsa B3 de Sao Paulo subió un 0,30%, a 186.104,75 puntos. * El Banco Central de Brasil recortó el miércoles su tasa de interés de referencia 25 puntos básicos, lo que supone la quinta baja consecutiva, tras más indicios de desaceleración económica antes de las elecciones presidenciales del próximo mes. * En Argentina, el peso mayorista se apreció un 0,20%, a 1.510,5 unidades por dólar , junto a una intervención diaria del banco central (BCRA). * "Seguimos con un mercado cambiario donde es difícil lograr el equilibrio, ya que el tipo de cambio en Argentina tiene una flotación sucia administrada", comentó Pablo Ludman, analista de Bull Market Brokers. * En tanto, el índice bursátil Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganó un 1,08% al cierre de negocios, contra una caída del 4,09% en las anteriores cuatro rondas, junto a un riesgo país que se mantenía levemente por encima de los 500 puntos básicos. * El peso chileno , retrocedió un 0,72%, a 959,40/959,70 por dólar, su mínimo nivel de cierre en casi un año y acumuló una caída semanal del 1,78%. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , subió un 1,30%, a 11.381,18 unidades. * Los mercados chilenos permanecerán cerrados el viernes debido a un feriado por la conmemoración de Fiestas Patrias. * El peso colombiano terminó con una caída de 1,26%, a 3.162,55 unidades por dólar, afectado por la decisión de la Reserva Federal estadounidense y la baja del precio del petróleo -importante generador de divisas del país-, mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) cerró con repunte de un 0,41%, a 2.522,12 puntos. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,36%, a 3,3560/3,3580 unidades por dólar. Por su parte, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) mejoraba un 1,71%, a 1.577,67 puntos.

item.title: US Health Secretary Kennedy Jr. adds eight new members to key health committee
item.description: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Thursday named eight new members to the advisory panel that decides which preventive medical care, such as routine cancer screening or HIV prevention, should be provided at no cost under health insurance plans.
item.dc:creator: Sriparna Roy
item.content:encoded: US Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. on Thursday named eight new members to the advisory panel that decides which preventive medical care, such as routine cancer screening or HIV prevention, should be provided at no cost under health insurance plans. The Preventive Services Task Force, which typically holds three annual meetings and has 16 members, last met a year ago. "The composition of this new slate represents a significant departure from the Task Force's traditional membership. We believe maintaining a strong primary care voice must remain central to its work," said Willie Underwood, president of the American Medical Association. The AMA added that recommendations should continue to be based on a transparent, rigorous and independent scientific process, while incorporating the perspectives of physicians who provide preventive care. This would be essential to maintaining clinicians' trust in the task force and encouraging patients to follow its recommendations, it said. Kennedy Jr. has reshaped several federal health advisory bodies, including the CDC's vaccine advisory committee, replacing its members after dismissing the entire panel last year. A [USN:L1N3ST0XO TEXT:"US Supreme Court decision"] affirmed Kennedy Jr.'s authority over the preventive care committee last June. The panel's November meeting following the judgment did not take place due to a government shutdown in 2025. A meeting in March was also postponed. This May, Kennedy Jr. removed the chair and vice chair of the influential task force. "The USPSTF has important work ahead to ensure critical recommendations catch up with the latest science so that patients can access lifesaving, preventive services like cancer screenings," said Lisa Lacasse, president of the American Cancer Society Cancer Action Network. Evercore ISI analysts said the new appointments provided "incremental confidence" that the task force was moving forward and that more updates could be expected in the near future. The panel's recommendations are a key catalyst for cancer screening tests such as Guardant Health's (GH.O) Shield blood test, the analysts added. The US Department of Health and Human Services declined to comment on the date of the panel's next meeting when contacted by Reuters. The new members include pediatric hematologist-oncologist Seth Corey, pediatrician Patrick Hunter and cardiovascular expert Ronald Karlsberg. Stephen Parente, who works in health finance, has also joined the panel. Professor of preventive cardiology Venkatesh Murthy, family medicine physician Goldie Stands-Over-Bull, Louis Wilson, a gastroenterology specialist, and Dennis Wulfeck, a diagnostic radiologist, were also named members. Comprising an independent group of volunteer experts, the panel relies on support from the Department of Health and Human Services' Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ). Meanwhile, Dr. Aaron Carroll, chief executive at AcademyHealth, an association of health researchers and policy analysts, said that while reconstituting the task force was a necessary step, "putting people back in the chairs doesn't rebuild the evidence system they need to do their job." Carroll noted that the AHRQ has lost 80% of its workforce and terminated more than 150 research grants relevant to health care delivery and preventive services.

China, US top diplomats discuss 'high-level interactions' in call, Beijing says

The call came a week ahead of an expected visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping to the US, with a meeting with President Donald Trump set to take place on Sep 24, Trump had said.

The flags of the United States and China fly from a lamp post in the Chinatown neighborhood of Boston, Massachusetts, US, on Nov 1, 2021. (File photo: Reuters/Brian Snyder)

FAST

BEIJING: Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on Thursday (Sep 17) told US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in a phone call that the two countries "should prepare well for the next stage of high-level interactions in the spirit of equality, respect and reciprocity", Wang's ministry said. Head-of-state diplomacy serves as the anchor of China-US ties, Wang said, adding that the two sides should strengthen communication, advance cooperation, manage differences and respect each other's core interests. The call came a week ahead of an expected visit by Chinese President Xi Jinping to the US, with a meeting with President Donald Trump set to take place on Sep 24, Trump had said. The official Chinese summary of the call fell short of explicitly confirming an upcoming meeting between Xi and Trump, but said Wang and Rubio "held in-depth discussions focused on high-level exchanges between the two countries". The two top diplomats also discussed the situation in the Middle East, the Chinese foreign ministry said, a day after Wang hosted Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Beijing for talks. In his meeting with Araghchi on Wednesday, Wang encouraged Iran and the US to remain rational, exercise restraint, return to the interim peace deal they signed in June and "engage in substantive consultations", while calling for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

Sept 17 : India's markets regulator has barred telecom infrastructure firm Kore Digital from raising money from the public and blocked its migration to the main stock exchange board, alleging financial irregularities. In a notification issued on Thursday, the Securities and Exchange Board of India said Kore Digital inflated revenue through non-genuine subsidiaries and manipulated financial statements. Here are more details: • SEBI said its findings showed that since Kore acquired three subsidiaries in late 2024, those units had accounted for about 75 per cent of the company's revenue on average.

item.content:encoded: Wall Street se recuperó el jueves porque una baja de los precios del petróleo, el descenso de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense y los sólidos datos de empleo ayudaron a los mercados a superar la primera subida de tasas de interés de la Reserva Federal en más de tres años. Los tres principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses cerraron con fuertes subidas, impulsados por un repunte liderado por el sector tecnológico, que situó al Nasdaq a la cabeza. "Estamos observando interés en los sectores del mercado que se han visto muy afectados ante la expectativa de esta subida de tasas de la Fed", dijo Robert Pavlik, gestor senior de carteras de Dakota Wealth. "Y la gente está entrando en el mercado, realizando algunas compras aprovechando el retroceso", agregó. Los precios del crudo cayeron y tocaron un mínimo de la semana después de que se calmó parte del temor a la interrupción del suministro gracias a las noticias de que el petróleo saudita circulaba por Omán. El petróleo recortó pérdidas, pero la tensión en Oriente Medio se mantuvo. Los precios de la energía se han disparado desde el inicio de la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán, lo que ha contribuido a aumentar las presiones inflacionistas a escala mundial. El miércoles, los responsables de política monetaria de la Fed votaron por unanimidad a favor de subir la tasa de interés objetivo de los fondos federales por primera vez desde julio de 2023. El comunicado del banco central indicaba que la Fed se comprometía a lograr un "retorno más oportuno" a su objetivo de inflación del 2 %, allanando el camino para nuevas medidas de endurecimiento este año. "El mercado se siente algo aliviado por la coherencia de la Fed, ya que todos votaron en el mismo sentido", dijo Ross Mayfield, analista de estrategia de inversión de Baird. "El presidente de la Fed, (Kevin) Warsh, volvió a hacer hincapié en la independencia de la Fed". El Índice de Volatilidad del Mercado de la CBOE (.VIX) , a menudo llamado "el índice del miedo", alcanzó su nivel más bajo en más de una semana, en línea con la baja de los precios del crudo. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 86,09 puntos, o un 1,14%, a 7.637,90 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 432,07 puntos, o un 1,66%, a 26.410,50. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) avanzó 319,73 puntos, o un 0,61%, a 51.774,38 unidades. Las empresas mineras de oro y plata (.XAU) y las de semiconductores (.SOX) estuvieron entre las de mejor desempeño.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[北京 １７日 ロイター] - 中国の王毅外相は１７日、ルビオ米国務長官と電話会談し、米中両国は「平等、尊重、互恵の精神に基づき、次の段階のハイレベル交流に向けて十分な準備を行うべきだ」との認識を伝えた。中国外務省が発表した。

王氏はさらに、「首脳外交は米中関係の要だ」とし、両国がコミュニケーション を強化し、協力を推進するとともに、相違点を適切に管理し、互いの核心的利益を尊重すべきだとの考えを明確にした。

電話会談では、中東情勢についても協議した。

FAST

BRASILIA, Sept 17 : Brazil's government is preparing an executive order to ban online casino operations in the country despite concerns over lost tax revenue and potential legal challenges from companies licensed to operate in the country, sources familiar with discussions within the presidential office told Reuters. Leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva, who has repeatedly signaled he wants to curb online gambling, is expected to sign off on the final text before the first round of general elections on October 4, according to three sources, who spoke on condition of anonymity. Lula and several of his right-wing rivals have made online gambling a frequent target on the campaign trail, as polls show growing concern over the state of the economy among voters. According to two of the sources, the ban would not extend to sports betting or sponsorship agreements involving sports clubs and competitions.

Companies, however, typically operate in both businesses, with gambling accounting for three-quarters of their revenue, according to the National Association of Gaming and Lotteries, an industry group. The licenses granted by the government last year cover both online casino games and sports betting. There are currently 188 authorized betting operators in Brazil. A separate source said Lula "wants and will take action," but discussions with ministers are ongoing. "We are discussing it. I have already held three meetings within the government and met with civil society, and my personal position is to end betting," the president said earlier this week, adding that the government must act responsibly. Officials acknowledge that banning online casinos while preserving sports betting would significantly reduce operators' revenues, affecting sports sponsorship spending and government tax receipts. Treasury data show the government collected nearly 10 billion reais ($1.95 billion) last year through licensing fees and taxes from the sector. Fixed-odds sports betting was legalized in Brazil in 2018, but the process of regulating and licensing operators was only completed during Lula's administration in 2024. HOUSEHOLD INDEBTEDNESS Lula's government has introduced a series of measures aimed at preventing excessive indebtedness, but spending on online betting has nevertheless risen sharply. The Finance Ministry estimates that Brazilians spend about 60 billion reais a year on betting, as banks and industry groups point to evidence that gambling is siphoning money away from consumer spending and household bills. The National Association of Gaming and Lotteries argues that any new restrictions should be preceded by studies that assess the economic and legal costs for companies already authorized to operate. Bernardo Cavalcanti Freire, the group's legal adviser, said changes that restrict activities covered by licenses for which operators paid concession fees could lead to claims for reimbursement and compensation. "Based on a preliminary estimate, compensation liabilities could reach 120 billion reais," he said. ($1 = 5.1341 reais)

Source: Reuters

item.content:encoded:
North Korea's Diplomatic Foray: Kim Son-Gyong at the UN Assembly Kim Son-Gyong, North Korea's vice foreign minister, will attend the UN General Assembly in New York. He plans to meet with UN officials and representatives from countries friendly to North Korea like Cuba and Venezuela. Kim will likely emphasize his country's stance on retaining its nuclear program. Devdiscourse News Desk | Updated: 18-09-2026 03:02 IST | Created: 18-09-2026 03:02 IST

SHARE

Key Takeaways AI Summary

Analyzing article...

Kim Son-Gyong, North Korea's vice foreign minister, is slated to participate in the upcoming UN General Assembly high-level segment in New York, sources have informed Yonhap news agency. The vice foreign minister's agenda includes meetings with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres and representatives from nations such as Cuba and Venezuela, which maintain amicable relations with North Korea. As reported, Reuters has yet to confirm these details. Kim intends to address the General Assembly from September 22 to 26 and again on September 28, potentially reiterating North Korea's stance on its nuclear program, a position he passionately upheld in last year's Assembly.

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Sept 17 : Amazon weighed in on the artificial intelligence safety debate roiling Silicon Valley, saying AI labs should ensure models are released only when they are safe and fully tested, but stopped short of calling for an industry slowdown. “"We don't see it as a choice between progress and safety,” a spokesperson for the Seattle firm told Reuters. “Models should be released when they're ready and safe to use, which comes from rigorous testing and strong safeguards.” The company provided its views in response to a Reuters inquiry days after many of the largest labs called for slower AI development, following an outcry among researchers and others who fear the technology could evade human control and threaten global systems and even humanity itself.  “There are risks if that doesn't happen collectively,” said Amazon, referring to progress in developing AI. “We believe that as an industry, in partnership with government, we'll work through the right protections.”
